title: consult-decision.v1
description: One line in .ledger/evo/runs/<run_id>/consult-log.jsonl. Append-only decision tape — replay reconstructs evo's CONSULTED state on resume. User_decision is closed-set; default_on_timeout is required per HARD-RULE 4.

decision_id.description: Stable id within a run; monotonic.

default_on_timeout.description: Fires after EVO_CONSULT_TIMEOUT_HOURS. Almost always 'reject' for safety (HARD-RULE 4).

decision_source.description: auto_applied = patch-version CVE fix where mode-c declared no consent required.

modification.description: If user_decision == 'modify', captures the changed instruction.
